description: Reviewed routes outside the command registry (spec 0006 §6.5). aq-server's route test fails on any mounted route that is neither a registered command route nor listed here. Adding a route here needs review.

Nest under the supervisor bearer with scope settings (aq-supervisor-control admin.rs): GET, HEAD and POST to the owner handlers under /api/settings/intelligence, /api/settings/internal-work, /api/internal-work/ and /api/playbooks/sources (there also PUT and DELETE) as the approving owner; any other path is 404. No CSRF header (the bearer is the authority); machine listener only.

Read-only git smart-HTTP under the supervisor bearer with scope owner (aq-supervisor-control git.rs), mounted only with supervisor_full_access and delivery_playbook and a configured delivery.git_http_socket: only GET info/refs?service=git-upload-pack and POST git-upload-pack are forwarded to aq-git, under a fixed read grant, for a project-bound repository (the global supervisor any, a project supervisor only its own project's); every other request, a push included, gets 403. Machine listener only.

Owner bridge under the supervisor bearer with scope owner (aq-supervisor-control owner.rs), mounted only with supervisor_full_access: any method, forwarded in process to the admin app at /{rest} as the approving owner, without the caller's authorization, cookie or dev-email headers and with x-aq-request set. Machine listener only.

Nest under the supervisor bearer with scope graph.read (aq-supervisor-control read.rs): GET and HEAD to result and attempt evidence as the approving owner. Project supervisors are scoped by retained project ownership and filtering of the result list and Dashboard feed. Their metadata list defaults to native v2 and exact metadata reads use the report's recorded origin when profile is omitted. The limited-access build also serves project task and knowledge reads here. Machine listener only.
